info.text:
Diesel averages $6.35 a gallon. Exxon's profit just doubled.
Exxon earned $15.4B in Q3 2026, up from $7.5B a year earlier.
Its refining unit earned $7.2B vs $7.1B from oil and gas production: per Reuters, the first time in at least six years refining came out ahead.
Chevron's refining profit rose from $1.1B to $4.9B in a year, as war-driven supply squeezes lifted fuel margins. EIA diesel average: $6.352 (week of Oct 26), about $2.63 above a year ago.
Sources: ExxonMobil and Chevron Q3 2026 releases (Oct 30, 2026), Reuters, EIA.
News and education, not financial advice.
